figure_candidates.label: Figure 4
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 4. In vitro functional characterization of Alp1J. a) EIC from LC–HRMS analysis of in vitro Alp1J assays under anaerobic conditions. i) NacHA
standard; ii) l-Asp + NaNO2 + Alp1J + Alp1I + Alp1N + MV/Na2S2O4; iii) l-Asp + NaNO2 + Alp1J (reconstituted) + Alp1I (reconstituted) +
Alp1N + MV/Na2S2O4; iv) l-Asp + NaNO2 + Alp1J-Alp1I (anaerobically co-puriﬁed) + Alp1N + MV/Na2S2O4; v) l-Asp + NaNO2 + Alp1J-1I
(anaerobically co-puriﬁed) + Alp1N + MV/SelFdR0978/NADPH; vi) l-Asp + NaNO2 + Alp1J-1I (aerobically co-puriﬁed) +
Alp1N + MV/SelFdR0978/NADPH; vii) l-Asp + NaNO2 + Alp1J-1I (aerobically co-puriﬁed) + MV/SelFdR0978/NADPH; (viii) HA standard. A 10-ppm
mass error tolerance was used for each trace. b) Schematic diagram of Alp1J and Alp1N-catalyzed reactions. c) Analytical size-exclusion
chromatography (SEC) analysis revealed the dimerization of the Alp1J-Ap1I heterodimer. The molecular weight of Alp1J monomer is 70.3 kDa and
Alp1I monomer with His6-tag is 14.3 kDa.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 5
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 5. Predicted structure of the Alp1J-1I complex. a) Cartoon diagram depicting the overall structure of the Alp1J-1I dimer-heterodimer. The two
monomeric Alp1J subunits are colored in forest-green and light-green, respectively, while the two monomeric Alp1I subunits are colored in salmon
and wheat, respectively. b) Alp1J (top), Alp1I (middle), and the complex of Alp1J and Alp1I (bottom). The three ﬁgures share the same orientation.
Alp1J is colored in forest-green and Alp1I in salmon. c) Catalytic pocket of Alp1J-1I docked with NO2−and l-Asp. Alp1J and Alp1I are displayed in
cartoon mode with forest-green and salmon colors, respectively. Heme is shown as red sticks; the [4Fe-4S] cluster is presented as a ball-and-stick
model (iron atoms as reddish-brown spheres, sulfur atoms as yellow spheres); NO2−is shown in spheres mode; and l-Asp is displayed as white
sticks. d) The entry channels for l-Asp and NO2−. The l-Asp channel is shown as deep-salmon spheres, and the NO2−channel as yellow spheres.
